title: Liber AL vel Legis — Thelemic Cipher Elements for Cryptographic Use
subtitle: The Book of the Law (Liber CCXX) — Structured Cipher Reference

structure.description: Liber AL vel Legis consists of three chapters attributed to three deities of the Thelemic cosmology

chapters.deity_epithet: Queen of Space / The Infinite Stars
chapters.summary: Had! The manifestation of Nuit. The chapter of Infinite Space, the circumference, the stars.
chapters.closing_verse: 66. The Manifestation of Nuit is at an end.

chapters.deity_epithet: The Winged Serpent of Light / The Point
chapters.summary: Nu! the hiding of Hadit. The chapter of the point, the center, the individual consciousness.
chapters.closing_verse: 79. The end of the hiding of Hadit; and blessing & worship to the prophet of the lovely Star!

chapters.deity_epithet: Horus / The Crowned and Conquering Child
chapters.summary: Abrahadabra; the reward of Ra Hoor Khut. The chapter of action, war, and the warrior.
chapters.closing_verse: 75. The ending of the words is the Word Abrahadabra.

isopsephia_and_gematria.description: Numerical values of key Thelemic terms using Greek isopsephia, Hebrew gematria, and English Qaballa

greek_isopsephy.note: Isopsephy assigns numerical values to Greek letters: Α=1, Β=2, Γ=3, Δ=4, Ε=5, Ϛ=6, Ζ=7, Η=8, Θ=9, Ι=10, Κ=20, Λ=30, Μ=40, Ν=50, Ξ=60, Ο=70, Π=80, Ϟ=90, Ρ=100, Σ=200, Τ=300, Υ=400, Φ=500, Χ=600, Ψ=700, Ω=800

aiwass.note: Digamma (ϝ) is the archaic letter value 6, used in Greek isopsephy

abrahadabra_hebrew.note: Crowley used 418, connecting to Aiwass; 419 is Teth in full spelling

english_qaballa_eq.discovered_by: James Lees (November 26, 1976); independently by Carol Smith (1974)
english_qaballa_eq.basis: AL 2:55 — 'Thou shalt obtain the order & value of the English Alphabet; thou shalt find new symbols to attribute them unto.'
english_qaballa_eq.method: Take every 11th letter of the alphabet starting from A=1, then assign sequential values

cipher_table.description: The 26 letters of the English alphabet assigned values 1-26 in the order: every 11th letter

al_cipher.description: The ALW cipher as it appears in Liber AL and Thelemic tradition
al_cipher.note: The cipher is embedded in the manuscript of AL III:47 through the 'chance shape of the letters and their position to one another'

manuscript_cipher.cipher_string: 4 6 3 8 A B K 2 4 A L G M O R 3 Y X 24 89 R P S T O V A L

lines.line_1: 4 6 3 8 A B K 2 4 A L G M O R 3 Y
lines.line_2: X 24 89 R P S T O V A L

solution.method: Jake Stratton-Kent solution: 17 elements in line 1 × 11 elements in line 2 = 187
solution.significance: Confirms the order & value of the English Alphabet

symbols.description: The Illuminati Cipher symbols correspond to each letter of the English alphabet
symbols.source: Crowley's tablet in Liber AL manuscript
symbols.note: Each letter has a unique symbol superimposed on the manuscript page of AL III:47. These symbols form the visual cipher key.

key_verses.description: Numerically significant verses used in Thelemic cipher operations

foundational_ch1.significance: Opening invocation; establishes the speaker as Nuit

foundational_ch1.text: Every man and every woman is a star.
foundational_ch1.significance: The Thelemic axiom of individual sovereignty
foundational_ch1.cipher_use: Star = 42 in EQ; key for identity operations

foundational_ch1.text: I am Nuit, and my word is six and fifty.
foundational_ch1.significance: Establishes Nuit's number as 56 (six and fifty)

foundational_ch1.text: The word of the Law is Θελημα.
foundational_ch1.significance: Defines Thelema (Θελημα) as the word of the Law

foundational_ch1.text: Do what thou wilt shall be the whole of the Law.
foundational_ch1.significance: The central ethical principle of Thelema

foundational_ch1.text: Nothing is a secret key of this law. Sixty-one the Jews call it; I call it eight, eighty, four hundred & eighteen.
foundational_ch1.significance: Reveals the key 418 (8, 80, 418); 61 = Jewish Shema reference

foundational_ch1.text: But they have the half: unite by thine art so that all disappear.
foundational_ch1.significance: Injunction to unite the halves (61 + 418 = ?; half = 8/2=4, 80/2=40, 418/2=209)

foundational_ch1.text: Invoke me under my stars! Love is the law, love under will. Nor let the fools mistake love; for there are love and love. There is the dove, and there is the serpent. Choose ye well!
foundational_ch1.significance: Instruction for invocation and the dual nature of love

foundational_ch1.text: I give unimaginable joys on earth: certainty, not faith, while in life, upon death; peace unutterable, rest, ecstasy; nor do I demand aught in sacrifice.
foundational_ch1.significance: Promise of certainty; 'certainty, not faith' = knowledge vs belief

foundational_ch1.text: My number is 11, as all their numbers who are of us.
foundational_ch1.significance: Nuit's number is 11; the cipher step
foundational_ch1.cipher_use: Primary modulus; 11 is the cipher step

chapter_2_key_verses.significance: Opening of Chapter 2; complements AL 1:1 'Had! The manifestation of Nuit.'

chapter_2_key_verses.text: In the sphere I am everywhere the centre, as she, the circumference, is nowhere found.
chapter_2_key_verses.significance: Hadit as the center point; complement to Nuit's circumference

chapter_2_key_verses.text: I am the flame that burns in every heart of man, and in the core of every star. I am Life, and the giver of Life, yet therefore is the knowledge of me the knowledge of death.
Thou shalt obtain the order & value of the English Alphabet; thou shalt find new symbols to attribute them unto.
chapter_2_key_verses.significance: The injunction that led to the discovery of English Qaballa
chapter_2_key_verses.cipher_use: Source verse for the ALW cipher

chapter_2_key_verses.text: Aye! listen to the numbers & the words:
chapter_2_key_verses.significance: Introduces the cipher string of AL 2:76

chapter_2_key_verses.text: 4 6 3 8 A B K 2 4 A L G M O R 3 Y X 24 89 R P S T O V A L.
chapter_2_key_verses.significance: The cipher string; verification of the English Qaballa

chapter_2_key_verses.text: Lift up thyself! for there is none like unto thee among men or among Gods! They shall worship thy name, foursquare, mystic, wonderful, the number of the man; and the name of thy house 418.
chapter_2_key_verses.significance: The 'name of thy house 418' — connects to Abrahadabra

chapter_3_key_verses.text: Abrahadabra; the reward of Ra Hoor Khut.
chapter_3_key_verses.significance: The word of the Aeon; 11 letters, value 418 (Hebrew) / 79 (EQ)

chapter_3_key_verses.text: Now let it be first understood that I am a god of War and of Vengeance. I shall deal hardly with them.
That stélé they shall call the Abomination of Desolation; count well its name, & it shall be to you as 718.

This book shall be translated into all tongues: but always with the original in the writing of the Beast; for in the chance shape of the letters and their position to one another: in these are mysteries that no Beast shall divine. Let him not seek to try: but one cometh after him, whence I say not, who shall discover the Key of it all. Then this line drawn is a key: then this circle squared in its failure is a key also.
chapter_3_key_verses.significance: The verse that contains the cipher key in the manuscript's letter shapes
chapter_3_key_verses.cipher_use: Source of the ALW cipher symbols

chapter_3_key_verses.text: There is no law beyond Do what thou wilt.
chapter_3_key_verses.significance: Completes the legal formula; 'Do what thou wilt' = no law
chapter_3_key_verses.cipher_use: Null/zero law; the ultimate cipher escape

chapter_3_key_verses.text: The ending of the words is the Word Abrahadabra.

numerical_constants.description: Key numbers used in Thelemic cipher operations

11.significance: The cipher step; the modulus; the number of Nuit

93.significance: Will and Love; the Thelemic greeting

187.significance: Proof of the cipher; the alphabet's self-value

418.significance: The Great Work accomplished; the Stele; the messenger

666.source: DCLXVI; the number of the Beast

derived_constants.419: Teth in Hebrew full spelling; Abrahadabra (Hebrew standard)

cryptographic_applications.description: How to use these cipher elements for encryption

key_derivation.method_1_verse_based: Use verse numbers (chapter:verse) as key indices
key_derivation.method_2_gematria: Sum letters of a Thelemic word using EQ values
key_derivation.method_3_mixed: Combine Greek isopsephia + EQ for dual-layer keys
key_derivation.method_4_eleven_based: Rotate by 11 (the cipher step) for polyalphabetic operations

cipher_methods.substitution_eq: Replace each letter with its EQ value (A=1, L=2, W=3...)
cipher_methods.transposition_verse: Use verse numbers as transposition key sequence
cipher_methods.modular_26: Standard mod 26 for letters, mod 93 for Thelemic operations
cipher_methods.dual_layer: Layer 1: EQ values; Layer 2: Greek isopsephia values

references.primary_source: Liber AL vel Legis (The Book of the Law), Aleister Crowley, 1904
references.equinox_journal: The New Equinox, edited by James Lees, 1981-1982
